description: Ask AI (Opus 5.5) to PROPOSE a resolution for each conflict block of a PR's text files — the Conflicts tab's 'Propose resolutions' button. Nothing is committed: each proposal (the block's lines, an explanation, a confidence 0..1) is stored for the (base, head) pair and shown on the Conflicts tab and in gluecron_list_pr_conflicts (`unresolved[].proposal`); accept a block with gluecron_resolve_pr_conflict `choices: {<hunk id>: 'ai'}`, edit it with a custom choice, or pick another option, then gluecron_commit_pr_conflict_resolution. Refused when the repository's merge-conflict mode is Manual only, when the PR author opted out of AI for conflicts, or when AI is unavailable (paused, not configured, over budget) — the error says which. A file over 60 KiB is reported too-large; repository text is sent as fenced data with secrets redacted. A file already proposed at this pair is not sent again unless again: true. Requires write access and 'repo' scope.

again.description: Ask again for files that already have a proposal at this pair (default false)

base_sha.description: Optional: baseSha from gluecron_list_pr_conflicts; a moved base is refused

head_sha.description: Optional: headSha from gluecron_list_pr_conflicts; a moved head is refused

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

paths.description: Optional: only these conflicted files (default: every text file without a saved resolution)

name: gluecron_propose_pr_conflict_resolution
